title: BaseLocalizationCohomologyAction
statement: For the commutative rings, compatible R and Rp algebra structures, localization S, complex Q and models L, K of [lem-pc-base-localization-map], every degree i, a in A and x in L.cohomology i satisfy f((a tensor 1) smul x) = (a tensor 1) smul f(x), where f is the canonical B-linear localization cohomology map. No invertibility hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine displayed localization identity; More on Algebra Tag 06Y6

proof.text: Apply naturality of baseLocalizationInputNatIso to a times the identity on Q. Apply L.derived and combine with naturality of baseLocalizationDerivedMap, obtaining the commuting square for the two derived multiplication endomorphisms. Apply B-homology. Cancel the target cohomology isomorphism, use cohomologyIso_smul for both models, and evaluate the resulting B-linear map equality at x.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6 universal counit and localization tensor identity

mathlib_searches.query: Derived tensor with an algebra over a localization agrees with derived tensor over the localized base
Derived tensor product commutes with localization of the base ring

lean.statement: theorem baseLocalizationCohomologyMap_smul (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S Rp] (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D) (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel Rp A B Q D) (i : ℤ) (a : A) (x : L.cohomology i) : baseLocalizationCohomologyMap R Rp B A D S Q L K i ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) a : A ⊗[R] B) • x) = (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := Rp) a : A ⊗[Rp] B) • baseLocalizationCohomologyMap R Rp B A D S Q L K i x
